subject: A quick plan for the weekend
text:
Hi there,

The weekend has shifted a bit because I need to help my sister move on Saturday morning, but I still want to spend the afternoon planning the site launch. After that, I’m heading to the river path with a thermos and a notebook, just to keep the mood light. If you are still comfortable with the new deadline, perhaps we could chat briefly on Sunday about what should move to the first round. No rush, and sorry for mixing work into what sounds like a messy plan!
